description: The image shows a Windows desktop with DBeaver database IDE open, displaying a SQL query editor on the left side containing a query with SELECT statements retrieving table metadata (table_size, table_name, time_created, etc.) from what appears to be a BigQuery information schema. On the right side, there's a dark terminal/console window showing execution output with a "Resolution" section indicating "PRE: 2022 - 2 quarters" and "POST: queries 3x22 through 3x23 (inclusive)" along with several date-based entries (2022-3x22-4x22, etc.) and a yellow status line at the bottom stating "Total processed this time: 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 quarters." The user appears to be running or reviewing the results of a data processing script that handles quarterly data migration or analysis.

The screen shows DBeaver SQL IDE (visible in the title bar "Extended Logic") with a SQL query editor on the left containing a complex SELECT query joining table_name and table_rows from tables with filtering conditions including table_size and table_rows operations. On the right side, there is a dark terminal/console window displaying execution results with a breakdown showing "PRE queries: 14s82 - 2 quarters" and "POST queries 2s12 through 5s21 inclusive", along with quarterly data from 2023 (2023-Apr2-Jul2, etc.) and a summary line stating "Total processed this time: 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 quarters". The user appears to be reviewing database query execution statistics, with the Windows taskbar visible at the bottom showing system tray icons and the time 9:11 AM.

The screenshot shows a split-screen workspace on what appears to be Windows with DBeaver (a database IDE) on the left side displaying SQL code with highlighted syntax including SELECT statements querying table metadata (table_size, table_rows, table_owner), and a dark terminal window on the right side showing script output with "Resolution:" section listing PRE and POST execution statistics including "2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries" and date-related entries like "2022-July/Aug". The user appears to be reviewing or running a database migration/comparison script, with the terminal showing completed processing results and the SQL editor containing diagnostic queries for analyzing table properties; the Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as approximately 9:07 AM.

The image shows Extended Logic SQL editor (visible in the window title bar at top left) with a SQL query open in the main editing pane on the left side. The SQL code appears to be selecting table metadata (table_size, table_name, time_created) with yellow/green syntax highlighting, and line numbers visible (lines 36-46 are partially readable). On the right side, there is a dark terminal/console window displaying execution results with a "Breakdown" section showing "PRE queries: *req1_1(v2 - 2 queries)" and "POST queries: 1re22 (through fy23 inclusive)" along with several dated entries and a summary line reading "Total processed this time - 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries". The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as 5:22 AM, and the cursor appears to be positioned in the terminal output area on the right.

The screenshot shows DBeaver (database management tool) on the left side with an SQL editor containing a complex query involving joins on tables (FROM time_x LEFT JOIN state source ON x.table_name = s.table_name) with columns like table_size, table_name, time_created, and what appears to be PostgreSQL-specific syntax including pg_size_pretty function. On the right side, there's a dark terminal/console window displaying execution results showing "Breakdown:" with PRE queries (vcl_135_final, 11 Ksqld8) and POST queries processing, with a summary line at the bottom reading "Total processed this time: 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries;" - the user appears to be running database analysis or migration scripts. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing this is running on Windows, and the DBeaver interface has multiple tabs open including "Queued >1" and "Messages" panels.
